title: Know Your Anchor in Christ
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner exposes the dangers of living in doubt and unbelief, and reveals the secret to truly growing as a Christian: knowing and speaking the word of God. Join Pastor Chris as he shares personal examples and biblical truths to show how a life anchored in God's word can experience miraculous breakthroughs and healings. Don't miss this life-changing message that will challenge you to speak faith and activate the power of God in your life.
